sections.h2: Which offices handle a Murray property tax bill
sections.html:
Valuing and collecting sit in separate hands. The Property Valuation Administrator (PVA) decides what the house is worth, while the Sheriff's Office sends the bills and takes the money. Its tax desk processes tens of thousands of bills a year and serves Murray and the rural parts of the county alike.

Take value questions and homestead or disability forms to the PVA, 270-753-3482. Take payments to the tax office, 701 Olive Street. After the sheriff's season closes, bills still unpaid are the county clerk's.

Murray State University is in Murray, and with a large rental share the housing stock turns over differently here than in farm counties.

Under KRS 134.015, early payers get 2% off, the next stretch costs face value through December 31, and penalties follow. The Calloway discount ends early, on a November 15 postmark.

Your bill carries its own dated schedule in the top right corner, and the amount climbs with each later date.

Calloway County payment steps
When you payWhat you owe
By November 15 (postmark)Face amount less 2%
Mid-November through December 31The printed amount, no extras
Throughout January5% penalty
Starting February 110% penalty and a sheriff's add-on fee

Cash, check, money order and online card payments are all taken. A bounced check costs $50, and penalties may apply again when you resend. Do not mail cash.

sections.h2: Where and how to pay in Murray
sections.html:
You can pay through a drop box, the mail, the counter or the website. The drop box, on the west side of 701 Olive Street, is never locked. The counter is staffed on weekdays from 8:00 a.m. to 4:30 p.m., and you should carry the bill.

  • Mail: stub plus check to 701 Olive St., Murray, KY 42071. Include a stamped return envelope if you want a receipt.
  • Website: the tax search page finishes with a receipt you can print.
  • Several bills together: fine by mail or at the counter when every stub is enclosed.
  • Phone: (270) 761-4TAX.

Pay the single balance due figure for your date. Splitting the payment among the state, county and school lines is not allowed.

sections.h2: Who pays the tax when a Calloway County house sells?
sections.html:
Typically the seller covers a prorated slice of the year at closing, and the buyer pays the full bill when it is issued. The settlement statement shows how yours works.

If closing comes before bills are issued, the title company holds back an estimate. Get the current balance from the tax office, and ask whether an older year is open, because past-due taxes are paid at the clerk, not the sheriff. An owner whose lender escrows still gets a copy of the bill.

The City of Murray lists property taxes on its online payments page too. Ask the city whether a bill is open on your parcel before choosing a closing date, and keep every receipt.

  • Request the sheriff's balance for the parcel.
  • Ask the clerk about any older delinquent year.
  • Check with the PVA that an exemption, if you have one, is on the account.
  • Hand the title company the bill number from your stub.

sections.h2: How to contest a Calloway County value
sections.html:
Talk to the PVA first and file with the clerk after the roll closes. The roll is open to the public for 13 days beginning the first Monday in May, and no appeal to the local board is allowed until you have had a PVA conference.

These hearings turn on proof. The board looks at land, buildings, rebuild cost and nearby sales. Because neighboring sales get adjusted for differences such as a basement, gather three or four recent Murray sales and note where your house differs.

File and then skip the hearing, and you cannot take the case further. Go with your papers. The board owes you a written reason for any increase or decrease, and you may record the hearing on audio.

If you live in the home and are 65 or older, or totally disabled, the homestead exemption may apply. Phone the PVA (270-753-3482) before paying if you think you qualify.

Only one exemption is allowed per household, and it belongs to the owner instead of the property, so your buyer files a new form. Owners who are totally disabled with a service-connected disability do not refile each year.

Under Section 172A of the Kentucky Constitution, farm acreage is valued on what it can produce, not on market price. That gap can be wide near town, so anyone selling acres should ask the PVA how the parcel is classed.

sections.h2: Preparing a Murray house for sale
sections.html:
Taxes are easiest to handle in a set order. Start with the PVA at 270-753-3482 and confirm the value and any exemption. Move to the tax office at 701 Olive Street and ask for the balance on your bill number. Then ask the clerk whether any earlier year is open, because those are paid there and not at the sheriff's counter.

With that done, you can tell a buyer or title company exactly what is owed and what is paid. Keep the printable receipt from the website, or the cancelled check if you mailed one, so there is proof when the closing agent asks. If you own acreage or a rental near campus, add one more call to the PVA about how each parcel is classed.

A paid receipt is the quickest way to settle a question from a lender, a buyer or the title company. The website produces one at the end of an online payment. By mail, the stamped return envelope brings one back, and a cancelled check can stand in. At the counter, ask for one. File whichever you get with your closing papers, along with a note of the bill number, so any later dispute about a missed year can be answered in minutes rather than weeks.

If a lender pays your tax from escrow, you can still ask the tax office to confirm the bill shows as paid before you set a closing date.

Calloway's typical owner-occupied home is worth $183,200 (2020 to 2024), and typical rent is $870 a month. Just 63.9 percent of homes are owner-occupied, and renters held 35.8 percent of occupied units in the 2020 count. Residents number 39,421 as of 2025, a 5.0 percent increase over 2020, with 20 permits issued in 2025. Commutes average 17.3 minutes, so a house near jobs and campus in Murray carries built-in appeal.

A courthouse fire in 1906 destroyed almost all of the county's early records, which is why old title questions sometimes need extra research.

A landlord with a rental near campus, an heir with a house in Murray, or an owner of a vacant farmhouse may sell as-is to a cash buyer, skipping financing delays and inspection repair requests. Any signed offer still depends on the tax payoff figures above, so line them up before you accept a closing date.

faqs.q: By when must I pay to get the Calloway County discount?
faqs.a: Payments postmarked by November 15 earn the 2% discount. The dated schedule on your bill is the final word.

faqs.q: Where is the sheriff's tax office in Murray?
faqs.a: 701 Olive Street. It serves weekdays until 4:30 p.m., and a drop box on the west side stays open all day and night. The phone is (270) 761-4TAX.

faqs.q: Does the sheriff take credit cards?
faqs.a: Yes, but only through the sheriff's website. Cash, check and money order are also accepted, and cash should never go in the mail.

faqs.q: Who pays the bill if my Murray house sells mid-year?
faqs.a: Normally you pay a prorated share at closing and the buyer pays the full bill once issued. The settlement statement shows the split.

faqs.q: Must I fix up a Calloway County house first?
faqs.a: No, a cash buyer can take it as-is. Unpaid property tax is settled from the proceeds, so request payoff amounts from the sheriff and clerk first.
